name: Jimmy Shah
biography: is a Mobile Security Researcher for McAfee, specializing in analysis of mobile threats on existing platforms (J2ME, Symbian, Windows Phone, iOS, Android) and potential mobile malware and spyware. He works with a team of researchers that regularly provides analysis and research on mobile threats to McAfee clients. He has presented on mobile threat research at a number of computer security conferences.
